Mo-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

...Although we've pretty much only just
arrived here, so if it's directions you need,
we might not be the ones to ask...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
It's not that I want to go somewhere-mo. I'm looking for my companions.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Did you get separated from them-mo?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
We didn't get separated-mo. We split up to survey the areas we were assigned-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
What point of that...?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
We measure things like the height and size of the land-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Oh! I forgot to introduce myself-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Accurate! Reliable! Proven results! Leave the surveying to me-mo! Unini of the Noponjaa![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Pleasure to meet you, Unini.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I'm Shulk, and these are Melia,
Nene and Kino.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Nice to meet you-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

My curiosity is a little piqued...
Might I ask what a 'Noponjaa' is?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Glad you asked-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Noponjaa is the name of our Nopon surveying team-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Any Nopon from Frontier Village should have heard of us at least once-mo?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Mo...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Nee-chan, have you heard of them-mo?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Dad might know about them-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

What a shock-mo... We've been inactive so long that our name recognition has really suffered...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Mo! Never mind that-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We Noponjaa came to survey the Giant's Shoulder-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But our leader, Wanawana, forgot to tell us where to meet afterward.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]So after surveying, none of us knows where to go-mo. Everyone else must be in trouble too-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]That's why I was going to look for everyone-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But there are monsters around, and even for me, finding everyone would be tough-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Apart from yourself, how many members
does your team number?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
There are eleven of them-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Eleven...? I see...
This is a vast land, so searching by
yourself certainly seems dangerous.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Do you know where your colleagues
might have gone?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Well... If it were only two...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Those two might know where the others are-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Then I'll start by looking for those two-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Wait-mo, Kino! We have other things we need to do...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I won't get in the way of your journey-mo! You all look strong, so I wanted to travel with you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And while you're on your way, I'd really like you to help me look for my companions-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
What do you think, Melia?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Do you really need to ask, Shulk?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I'll help look for your companions-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
That's Melia-san's line-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Really-mo!? Unini is so moved-mo! Thank you-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Can you tell us, to the best of your
knowledge, where you would expect your
colleagues to be?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

One of them is assigned from the slope at the three-way fork on the way to Companions'[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Cape all the way to Nerve Cemetery-mo. They're timid, so I'm worried whether they're surveying properly-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

The other covers the pond left of this cave and the area around Pillar Hill-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]They may be shouting because something unexpected happened-mo. I want to put their mind at ease-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I can't just rely on you for free-mo. If something happens, Unini will be useful too-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I feel better already.
Thank you, Unini.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Leave it to me-mo! I look forward to working with you too-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
